subject: Sequenced staging, surge-fallback, and pin rollback — AcmeHealth VPC
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acmehealth.com, dbadmin@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upgrade windows and rollback plan for Private VPC (AcmeHealth)

Hi Vivek / Karthik,

We're planning the quarterly maintenance for our private deployment (cluster pinned to 1.18.3) and need to coordinate a two-week staged upgrade to 1.19.x plus a fast rollback path if tokenization or KV cache regressions appear. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood provide a staged pinset and a short maintenance MOP we can run (hours per wave, required drains, post-upgrade checks)?
2) We need a defined surge-fallback so we can divert traffic to a warm fallback pool if latency goes above 300ms P95 for more than 10 minutes.

Attached is our initial internal timeline and network diagram. We've blocked the first wave the week of Sep 6. Can you confirm what you need from us (credentials, expected traffic windows, whether we need to open NACL ports for health probes)?

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Sr. Platform Ops — AcmeHealth
attachments: acme_mop_draft_v2.pdf, network-topology-annotated.png
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acmehealth.com>, ops@acmehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade windows and rollback plan for Private VPC (AcmeHealth)

Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. High level confirmation and what we'll deliver:

- Deliverables from Redwood before first wave:
  * Staged pinset CSV (current pin + candidate + staged promotion order) — see pinset-matrix.csv (attached).
  * Maintenance Operating Procedure (MOP) with timeboxed steps, KV cache warmup, and validation scripts.
  * Surge-fallback runbook: how to reduce batch sizes, redirect traffic to warm fallback pool, and how to trigger an automated rollback.

- Technical notes / immediate asks from you:
  * Health probe IPs used by your LB so we can whitelist on firewall rules.
  * Expected steady-state tail latency and traffic mix (L2 threads/minute, embedding calls %).
  * Whether you can accept short connection draining (30s) during pod rotation.

Proposed staged waves:
  Wave 1: 10% traffic, non-critical regions, 02:00–06:00 local. Validation 4 hours.
  Wave 2: 30% traffic, expanded nodes, 02:00–07:00 local. Validation 6 hours.
  Wave 3: 60% traffic, full config, 02:00–08:00 local. Final validation 8 hours.

Rollback criteria (summary):
  - Latency P95 > 300ms for 10 continuous minutes despite batch/retry tuning.
  - >1% error increase over baseline for 5 minutes.
  - Regression in tokenization output or hallucination rate on canary prompt set.

I'll attach a draft of the MOP by EOD today. For now, can Karthik and Hannah confirm whether the proposed wave windows work from an infra gating perspective?

— Vivek
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
attachments: pinset-matrix.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade windows and rollback plan for Private VPC (AcmeHealth)

Quick internal alignment notes — copying the people who own the infra steps:

- Networking: we need Acme to confirm source IP CIDR for health checks. We'll ask infra to pre-authorize those in the transit VPC and confirm NACL timeouts. Without explicit CIDR, we default to a broadband open window which they won't accept.

- Drains & State: drains should be graceful and KV cache should be pre-warmed using a warmup job after each pod becomes Ready. Monica, can your team schedule the warmup job and validate KV hit-rate metrics (target >= 85% within 10 minutes)?

- Surge-fallback: our warm fallback pool (dedicated smaller model variant) is ready but we need a single toggle that changes routing policy per region. Dev — is the toggle exposed in the control plane for this customer? If not, we need a quick feature flag with a manual override.

- Rollback automation: we'll prepare a one-click rollback that restores the pinned version and drains new pods. Note: one-click will not restore any DB schema changes — confirm with ACME if schema changes are expected.

Action owners:
  - Karthik: firewall/NACL checklist and validation criteria (due 2027-08-26).
  - Monica: KV warmup job and metrics dashboard (due 2027-08-27).
  - Dev: control plane toggle or manual procedure (due 2027-08-26).

If we hit any of the rollback criteria, cadence for exec escalation: first phone to Olivia, then chart to CS lead.

— Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acmehealth.com, dbadmin@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade windows and rollback plan for Private VPC (AcmeHealth)

Thanks Vivek & team — this looks good. Quick answers:

- Health probes CIDR: 34.200.128.0/20 and 52.44.0.0/18 (we will add temporary rules for the maintenance window).
- No DB schema changes planned — we only bump inference runtime.
- We agree to the wave windows shown and will provide traffic mix CSV by 2027-08-26.

We'll review your MOP when you send it tonight. Once we have the firewall rules and the warmup verification dashboard, we'll lock the first wave.

Olivia
Sr. Platform Ops — AcmeHealth
